description:
Goal

A demanded callable TransportShape(position) refines exact carried producer relations into one physical representation. ABI, backend, interpreter, and native consumers use that answer; none reselect producer identity from types, joined demand surfaces, ShapeIds, ordering, or session inventories.

North-star contract

- There is no transport seal, completion pass, or whole-world census.
- One requested product either produces from its exact current fact/product children or returns exact waits.
- Completion is revision-relative to the exact publisher frontier already requested by that product DAG. If three publishers are requested, the third current production completes that frontier. A later request creates a new frontier revision and invalidates dependent answers.
- Only actual product back-edges may be settled as one cyclic group. A recursive dependency cone is not automatically an SCC.
- RootBackendProduct only packages products already demanded by the request-local DAG.

Proven requested boundary

Spike bf021f6fecba4f0db57989dbb4aafa92de3a2ae3 traced the actual paired Enum.drop_while multi-producer slot, reduce_while_cont input 2, through the production driver.

The full current solve projected 25 executables, computed 207 equality components and 408 positions. The requested component itself had exactly 1 position, 1 anchor, and 0 equalities. It is not an SCC and provides no justification for grouped transport settlement.

The input had two carried sources. Each source independently projected Exact to a distinct callable ShapeId. callable_input_shapes_for_demand accepted zero, so aggregate projection returned Unknown and the graph installed a generic callable fallback. Reversing publisher order produced the identical result. The semantic producer relations are already valid; physical selection is deleting both and reconstructing eligibility from a joined rendering.

The current source projection touched an 18-executable context cone. That is measured recursive dependency, not proof that all 18 are necessary or cyclic. The correct product boundary must discover exact child position products and group only proven back-edges.

Proven completion-model break

- OutgoingInputEdges(E) returns Unit after appending edges into session maps. The edge value is separated from the product that computed it.
- IncomingInputSlot(slot) has no waits. It can settle as empty while a known OutgoingInputEdges publisher is already requested and waiting.
- ProductMemo does not retain an addressable requested/pending frontier after a waiting producer unblocks.
- OutgoingInputEdges is never invalidated when demand-derived inputs move. Its Unit memo and append-only edges survive, so publisher contributions cannot replace or withdraw.
- CallableFacts and BoundaryFacts snapshot optional pass-side inventories rather than derive from named products.
- solve_transport_closure overproduces unrelated components and side-publishes the inventories that RootBackendProduct later treats as requests.

Required physical refinement

The incoming producer/use relation is authority. Transport consumes every complete carried relation.

- Zero relations is incomplete or absent according to the exact upstream domain; it is not permission to invent a semantic fallback.
- One relation may use a direct representation only when carried authority says the position is direct-only. Otherwise it uses the public carrier.
- Multiple producer identities retain all alternatives and use their common public boxed callable ABI. Physical equality never chooses identity.

Remaining proof gate before production implementation

Choose and prove the smallest permanent publisher-frontier authority. A viable model must:

1. Make OutgoingInputEdges(E) an immutable full contribution rather than Unit plus append-only side effects.
2. Retain exact requested-versus-produced publisher state for the current frontier without scanning World or declaring semantic closure.
3. Make IncomingInputSlot wait while any publisher in that frontier is pending.
4. Treat a later requested publisher as a new frontier revision and invalidate the old aggregate.
5. Replace a revised publishers prior contribution, including withdrawal.
6. Expose exact generations/revisions so dependent position products cannot memoize partial answers.

The spike proves these requirements and proves no current authority satisfies them. It does not yet choose between a dedicated frontier product, a product-driver request index, or an explicit frontier value carried by the parent DAG.

Candidate product recursion to prove after that choice

TransportShape(Input)
  -> current IncomingInputSlot
  -> exact TransportShape(Value(producer, value)) children
  -> common physical ABI over every carried relation

Each value product should consume immutable local structural source facts plus exact recursively named position products. A proposed raw TransportSourceFacts(E) may contain local positions, equalities, anchor recipes, input-slot references, callable producer descriptors, and already-selected semantic mappings. It must not project ShapeIds or read neighboring executable contexts. Historical ExecutableTransportFacts failed because it performed context-sensitive projection; it is not a reusable model.

Callable construction is a separate producer-position product. CallableFacts and BoundaryFacts must derive from named construction products or wait; they must not snapshot optional session maps.

Implementation decomposition after the frontier proof

1. Immutable outgoing edge contributions plus exact frontier and replacement/withdrawal semantics.
2. Local raw source facts with exact fact and RuntimeDemand dependencies.
3. Exact recursive position products with grouping only for proven back-edges.
4. Carried-relation callable refinement and deletion of physical producer selection.
5. Producer-position callable construction plus derived callable/boundary products.
6. Consumer cutover and removal of closure solve, side inventories, dense invalidation compensation, and lower-layer reconstruction.

Signal

- A pending known publisher blocks IncomingInputSlot; the final requested publisher completes it.
- Later request and publisher revision move the frontier and exactly invalidate dependents.
- The paired input pulls exactly both producer-value children and no unrelated component.
- Both valid producers survive into one public callable ABI; same-layout distinct identities cannot cross-select.
- Tests assert exact requests, waits, revisions, withdrawals, child products, and consumer behavior.
- Whole-closure projection, snapshot facades, physical selector/fallback, manufactured demand, and obsolete cache tests are removed rather than compensated.

Scope

No production implementation begins until the frontier authority and its replacement protocol are proven. fz-k22.30 remains blocked here. fz-k22.31 owns the uncalled first-class discrepancy. fz-k22.29 may consume the eventual authority only after it exists.
title: Make callable transport determination a product-owned refinement
